```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(stringi)
library(broom)
library(reshape2)
library(ggpmisc)
source("function/convert_ppm_min_flux.R")
```

```{r}
files <- list.files("data/tidy/240611", pattern = "ppm")
ghg_ppm <- lapply(paste0("data/tidy/240611/", files), read_csv) %>% bind_rows()
ghg_ppm
```

```{r}
min_elapsed <- read_csv("data/tidy/240611/240611_min_elapsed.csv")
ghg_ppm <- ghg_ppm %>% 
  mutate(ecosystem = case_when(
    grepl("P", rep) ~ paste0(ecosystem, "P"),
    TRUE ~ ecosystem
  )) %>% 
  mutate(rep = str_remove(rep, "P")) %>% 
  separate(rep, c("pref", "suff"), "-") %>% 
  mutate(pref = as.numeric(pref),
         suff = as.numeric(suff)) %>% 
  left_join(min_elapsed, by = c("ecosystem", "pref", "suff", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(date_collected = "240611",
         ecosystem = case_when(
           is.na(pref) ~ paste0(ecosystem, "P"),
           TRUE ~ ecosystem
         ))
ghg_ppm
```
### CO2

Get fluxes and p-values

```{r}
ghg_ppm %>%
    filter(ecosystem %in% c("Pr", "NWd", "SWd", "Wt"),!is.na(co2_ppm)) %>% 
  nest_by(ecosystem, pref, suff) %>% 
  mutate(lm_co2 = list(lm(co2_ppm ~ min_elapsed, data = data))) %>%
  summarize(tidy(lm_co2)) %>% 
  filter(term == "min_elapsed") 


#show only non significant p values
ghg_ppm %>%
    filter(ecosystem %in% c("Pr", "NWd", "SWd", "Wt"),!is.na(co2_ppm)) %>% 
    ## Code to filter out bad time points
  # mutate(
  #   co2_ppm = case_when(
  #   ecosystem == "NWd" & pref == 3 & suff %in% c(1, 2) & timepoint == "t3" ~ NA,
  #   TRUE ~ co2_ppm),
  # ) %>%
  nest_by(ecosystem, pref, suff) %>% 
  mutate(lm_co2 = list(lm(co2_ppm ~ min_elapsed, data = data))) %>%
  summarize(tidy(lm_co2)) %>% 
  filter(term == "min_elapsed",p.value>.05) #show only fluxes, not intercepts

```

# Minimum Detectable Flux for CH4 and N2O

```{r calc-mdf}
chamber_vols <- read_csv("data/tidy/2024_chamber_vols.csv") %>%
  select(1:3,11)

chamber_temps <- read_csv("data/tidy/240611/240611_chamber_temps.csv")%>%
  select(2:4,7)

# ghg_ppm <- ghg_ppm %>%
#   left_join(chamber_vols) %>%
#   left_join(chamber_temps)


mdf <- ghg_ppm %>%
   left_join(chamber_vols) %>%
   left_join(chamber_temps) %>%
  mutate(chamber = paste0(ecosystem,pref,"-",suff))%>%
  group_by(gc_run_date,chamber)%>%
  reframe(mdf_ch4 = (10.2*ch4_precision/100)/(30*60)*(total_vol_m3/.05)*(1000/(.08205736*average_temp_kelvin))*1000,
            mdf_n2o = (1*n2o_precision/100)/(30*60)*(total_vol_m3/.05)*(1000/(.08205736*average_temp_kelvin))*1000) %>%
  reframe(mean_mdf_ch4 = mean(mdf_ch4, na.rm=T),
          mean_mdf_n2o = mean(mdf_n2o, na.rm=T))
```

```{r calc-ch4-flux}

ghg_ppm_lm <- ghg_ppm %>%
  filter(ecosystem %in% c("Pr","NWd","SWd","Wt"),,!is.na(co2_ppm)) %>%
  nest_by(ecosystem, pref, suff) %>% 
  mutate(lm_co2 = list(lm(co2_ppm ~ min_elapsed, data = data)),
         lm_ch4 = list(lm(ch4_ppm ~ min_elapsed, data = data)),
         lm_n2o = list(lm(n2o_ppm ~ min_elapsed, data = data)))

co2 <- ghg_ppm_lm %>%
  summarize(tidy(lm_co2)) %>% 
  filter(term == "min_elapsed") %>%
  mutate(gas="co2")

ch4 <- ghg_ppm_lm %>%
  summarize(tidy(lm_ch4)) %>% 
  filter(term == "min_elapsed") %>%
  mutate(gas="ch4")

n2o <- ghg_ppm_lm %>%
  summarize(tidy(lm_n2o)) %>% 
  filter(term == "min_elapsed") %>%
  mutate(gas="n2o")

fluxes <- co2 %>%
  bind_rows(ch4) %>% bind_rows(n2o) %>%
  left_join(chamber_vols) %>%
  left_join(chamber_temps)%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(flux = convert_ppm_min_flux(gas, estimate, total_vol_m3,average_temp_kelvin)) %>%
  mutate(flux = case_when(
    gas == "ch4" & p.value > .05 ~ 0,
    gas == "n2o" & p.value > .05 ~ 0,
    gas == "ch4" & p.value < .05 & abs(flux) < mdf[1] ~ 0,
    gas == "n2o" & p.value < .05 & abs(flux) < mdf[2] ~ 0,
    .default = flux
  )) %>%
mutate(units = case_when(
  gas == "co2" ~ "umol_m2_s1",
  gas == "ch4" ~ "nmol_m2_s1",
  gas == "n2o" ~ "nmol_m2_s1"))

write_csv(fluxes, "data/final/240611/240611_fluxes.csv")
```

```{r check-methane-n2o}
ch4 %>%
  left_join(chamber_vols) %>%
  left_join(chamber_temps)%>%
  mutate(flux = convert_ppm_min_flux(gas, estimate, total_vol_m3,average_temp_kelvin)) %>%
  filter(p.value<.05)

n2o %>%
  left_join(chamber_vols) %>%
  left_join(chamber_temps)%>%
  mutate(flux = convert_ppm_min_flux(gas, estimate, total_vol_m3,average_temp_kelvin)) %>%
  filter(p.value<.05)

```
